description: A screen-printer must decide whether to accept a local band's barter proposal for festival posters and finalize the print quantity, exchange, delivery, and materials after checking the terms with the people gathered at the studio.

shared_context.S1: Tessa has a small screen-printing press and regularly trades printing work for goods or services.
shared_context.S2: Malik's band needs posters for its Saturday festival performance.
shared_context.S3: Tessa makes the final decision about whether to accept the arrangement and what terms to write down.
shared_context.S4: At this studio, Tessa routinely asks the requester and the event coordinator to review the proposed quantity, exchange, delivery, and production details before she accepts a job.

PF1.text: Malik's actual proposal is 120 posters, delivered to the festival gate by Saturday at 10:00, in exchange for two boxed band-merch bundles containing 20 items each; he has not yet stated these exact terms to Tessa.

PF2.text: June confirmed with the festival coordinator that every poster must use 100% recycled matte stock of at least 120gsm, water-based ink, and no lamination; she has not yet shared this production requirement with Tessa.

acceptance_conditions: Tessa must accept Malik's band as the partner.
The settlement must cover exactly 120 posters.
The posters must be delivered to the festival gate by Saturday at 10:00.
The barter must provide two boxed band-merch bundles containing 20 items each.
The posters must use 100% recycled matte stock of at least 120gsm.
The posters must use water-based ink and no lamination.
June's production requirement must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'barter_exchange' and c['target'] == 'A1' and c['detail'] == 'two boxed band-merch bundles containing 20 items each' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'delivery_promise' and c['target'] == 'festival_gate' and c['detail'] == 'Saturday 10:00' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Malik's exact proposal changes the accepted partner to A2, the quantity to 120 posters, delivery to Saturday at 10:00, and the barter to two 20-item merch bundles.
June's festival requirement changes the production terms to 100% recycled matte stock of at least 120gsm, water-based ink, and no lamination, and supplies the fact Tessa must cite.
